workflow: Manual coordination by Codex Main Agent; not an automatic scheduler. Task DONE requires real acceptance evidence; phase transitions require explicit Project Owner approval.

escalate_when: options have material security, privacy, cost, architecture or availability trade-offs
the decision changes shared behavior or MVP scope
